topic.label: Drones and UAV Operations
topic.desc: Drones and UAV Operations: Flight Control and Autopilot, Applications and Purpose, Mission Planning and Data, Manufacturers and Platforms, Regulation and Airspace, Payloads and Sensors, Airframe Types and Planetary and Extreme-Environment UAVs.

concepts.label: Applications and Purpose
concepts.desc: What drones are used for: survey and mapping, inspection, agriculture and similar work.

concepts.label: Flight Control and Autopilot
concepts.desc: Autopilot configuration, flight modes, MAVLink and failsafes.

concepts.label: Mission Planning and Data
concepts.desc: Planning waypoint missions and processing the imagery and logs they produce.

concepts.label: Payloads and Sensors
concepts.desc: Cameras, gimbals, LiDAR and multispectral sensors carried by drones.

concepts.label: Planetary and Extreme-Environment UAVs
concepts.desc: Unmanned aerial vehicles for the Moon, Mars and other places with little or no air: why propellers need an atmosphere, thruster-based flight, low gravity, dust and cold.

concepts.label: Manufacturers and Platforms
concepts.desc: Makers of drones and autopilots, and the open flight-control stacks, compared from public specifications.

concepts.label: Regulation and Airspace
concepts.desc: Airspace classes, operating rules, record keeping and risk assessment, which differ by country.

concepts.label: Airframe Types
concepts.desc: Multirotor, fixed-wing, VTOL and helicopter airframes and what each is suited to.

skills.label: Agriculture Flight Planner
skills.desc: Plans crop-monitoring flights with a multispectral or visual camera and the index maps to produce afterwards.

skills.label: Infrastructure Inspection Planner
skills.desc: Plans inspection flights for structures such as towers and roofs, with standoff distance, camera angles and what to record.

skills.label: Survey and Mapping Mission Planner
skills.desc: Plans an aerial survey with altitude, image overlap and ground control for the accuracy the client needs.

skills.label: Autopilot Configurator
skills.desc: Reviews autopilot parameters, flight modes and tuning for a vehicle and flags settings that need a test flight.

skills.label: Failsafe Designer
skills.desc: Defines geofence, return-to-home and battery or link-loss failsafes and lists how each one should be tested.

skills.label: MAVLink Integrator
skills.desc: Connects a companion computer or software to a flight controller over MAVLink and tests the messages in simulation first.

skills.label: Flight Log Analyst
skills.desc: Reads flight logs for vibration, battery sag, GPS quality and mode changes and explains anomalies.

skills.label: Orthomosaic and Point Cloud Processor
skills.desc: Turns survey imagery into an orthomosaic, elevation model and point cloud and reports the accuracy against check points.

skills.label: Waypoint Mission Planner
skills.desc: Builds a waypoint mission with altitude, speed, overlap and battery reserve and simulates it before upload.

skills.label: Camera and Gimbal Planner
skills.desc: Chooses a camera, lens and gimbal settings for a task and computes ground sample distance.

skills.label: LiDAR and Multispectral Planner
skills.desc: Matches LiDAR or multispectral sensors to a mapping or crop task and sets point density or band requirements.

skills.label: Thin-Atmosphere Rotorcraft Sizer
skills.desc: Sizes rotors for the thin carbon dioxide air of Mars from gravity, air density and blade tip speed, with cold-night heating and a reference to the Ingenuity Mars helicopter.

skills.label: Planetary Flight Feasibility
skills.desc: Decides whether an unmanned aircraft can fly on the Moon, Mars or another body from its gravity and atmosphere density: rotors and wings need air, so the airless Moon rules out propellers and calls for thrusters.

skills.label: Vacuum Thruster UAV Designer
skills.desc: Designs a thruster-driven hopper or flying UAV for an airless world such as the Moon, with lunar gravity, propellant budget, landing legs and regolith dust that must not reach the engines.

skills.label: Manufacturer Comparator
skills.desc: Compares drone makers and platforms on published specifications, software support and update policy, and marks every claim with its source.

skills.label: Open Autopilot Stack Guide
skills.desc: Compares open autopilot software such as PX4 and ArduPilot on supported vehicles, ground-station tools and licensing, from their documentation.

skills.label: Airspace Checker
skills.desc: Collects airspace class, restrictions and notice requirements for a location from official sources and flags that the pilot must confirm them with the aviation authority.

skills.label: Flight Record Keeper
skills.desc: Keeps a flight log of aircraft, pilot, battery cycles and maintenance in the form an authority may ask for.

skills.label: Operational Risk Assessor
skills.desc: Writes a pre-flight risk assessment covering people, property, weather and equipment and lists the mitigation for each risk.

skills.label: Airframe Selector
skills.desc: Chooses between multirotor, fixed-wing and VTOL for a task from range, payload, landing space and wind.

skills.label: Endurance and Payload Estimator
skills.desc: Estimates flight time and usable payload from mass, battery capacity and drag and states the assumptions.
